select streamer_no, current_result, current_streak, max_win_streak, max_win_start, max_win_end, max_lose_streak, max_lose_start, max_lose_end, streak_updated_at from ck_streak
select * from ck_streak where current_result = 'W' order by current_streak desc, max_win_streak desc
select * from ck_streak order by max_win_streak desc

select count(*) from ck_participant where ck_streamer = #{value}
mapper.update:
MERGE INTO ck_streak target USING ( WITH result_list AS ( select cp.ck_streamer AS streamer_no, c.ck_id, c.ck_date, CASE WHEN c.ck_winner = cp.ck_side THEN 'W' ELSE 'L' END AS result FROM ck c JOIN ck_participant cp ON c.ck_id = cp.ck_id WHERE cp.ck_streamer IN
#{streamerNo}
),
change_flag AS ( select r.*, CASE WHEN LAG(result) OVER ( PARTITION BY streamer_no ORDER BY ck_date, ck_id ) = result THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS changed FROM result_list r ),
grouped AS ( SELECT c.*, SUM(changed) OVER ( PARTITION BY streamer_no ORDER BY ck_date, ck_id ) AS streak_group FROM change_flag c ),
streak_groups AS ( SELECT streamer_no, result, streak_group, COUNT(*) AS streak_count, MIN(ck_date) AS streak_start, MAX(ck_date) AS streak_end,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY streamer_no, result ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(ck_date) DESC ) AS result_rank FROM grouped GROUP BY streamer_no, result, streak_group ),
current_data AS ( SELECT streamer_no, result AS current_result, COUNT(*) AS current_streak FROM ( SELECT g.*, MAX(streak_group) OVER (PARTITION BY streamer_no) AS last_group FROM grouped g ) WHERE streak_group = last_group GROUP BY streamer_no, result ),
max_win AS ( SELECT streamer_no, streak_count AS max_win_streak, streak_start AS max_win_start, streak_end AS max_win_end FROM streak_groups WHERE result = 'W' AND result_rank = 1 ),
max_lose AS ( SELECT streamer_no, streak_count AS max_lose_streak, streak_start AS max_lose_start, streak_end AS max_lose_end FROM streak_groups WHERE result = 'L' AND result_rank = 1 )
SELECT cd.streamer_no, cd.current_result, cd.current_streak,
NVL(mw.max_win_streak, 0) AS max_win_streak, mw.max_win_start, mw.max_win_end,
NVL(ml.max_lose_streak, 0) AS max_lose_streak, ml.max_lose_start, ml.max_lose_end
FROM current_data cd
LEFT JOIN max_win mw ON cd.streamer_no = mw.streamer_no
LEFT JOIN max_lose ml ON cd.streamer_no = ml.streamer_no
) source
ON ( target.streamer_no = source.streamer_no )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.current_result = source.current_result, target.current_streak = source.current_streak,
target.max_win_streak = source.max_win_streak, target.max_win_start = source.max_win_start, target.max_win_end = source.max_win_end,
target.max_lose_streak = source.max_lose_streak, target.max_lose_start = source.max_lose_start, target.max_lose_end = source.max_lose_end,
target.streak_updated_at = SYSDATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( streamer_no,
current_result, current_streak,
max_win_streak, max_win_start, max_win_end,
max_lose_streak, max_lose_start, max_lose_end,
streak_updated_at ) VALUES ( source.streamer_no,
source.current_result, source.current_streak,
source.max_win_streak, source.max_win_start, source.max_win_end,
source.max_lose_streak, source.max_lose_start, source.max_lose_end,
SYSDATE )
